Anatomical stations of the pyramidal tract (cortex to cord)

Source: R/pyramid.R
pyt_stations.Rd

Ordered stations along the tract, as a fraction of the total arc length (fraction, in [0, 1]) and as a depth in millimetres measured from the motor-cortex surface along the pathway (depth_mm, at the default tract_length = 75 mm).

Usage

pyt_stations()

Value

A data frame with one row per station and columns station (ordered factor), fraction, depth_mm (at the default tract_length = 70 mm).

Examples

pyt_stations()
#>   station fraction depth_mm
#> 1  cortex     0.00      0.0
#> 2  corona     0.10      7.0
#> 3 centrum     0.20     14.0
#> 4      ic     0.35     24.5
#> 5    crus     0.50     35.0
#> 6    pons     0.60     42.0
#> 7 pyramid     0.72     50.4
#> 8     dec     0.82     57.4
#> 9    cord     1.00     70.0
